items.html: Thus they are one Bina and three Tevunot, and all these four phases are called the Tevuna of SAG of the first Hey. There is also a supernal Bina, alluded to in the Yud of HaVaYaH, and it resembles all these phases, except that it is called the Bina of Ehyeh of the Yudin. Thus there is a supernal Bina and a Tevuna, which are the secret of SAM of balsam, and likewise within Tevuna itself there is a Bina and a Tevuna, and these too are the SAM of balsam.
